shortBio.en: Germs guitarist; Nirvana In Utero–tour second guitar; Foo Fighters rhythm guitar.
shortBio.zh: Germs 吉他手；Nirvana In Utero 巡演第二吉他；Foo Fighters 节奏吉他。

whyHub.en: Nirvana ↔ Foo Fighters guitar bridge after Grohl’s drum-to-front move.
whyHub.zh: Grohl 鼓转主唱之后的 Nirvana ↔ Foo Fighters 吉他桥。

body.en:
Born 1959. Germs / LA punk résumé before joining Nirvana as second guitar for the In Utero tour (1993–94). Joins Foo Fighters early; leaves mid-90s; returns as touring/studio rhythm guitar.

Related: Seattle–LA punk wire into Foo Fighters’ personnel continuity.
body.zh:
1959 年生。Germs / 洛杉矶朋克履历后，以第二吉他加入 Nirvana 的 In Utero 巡演（1993–94）。早期加入 Foo Fighters；90 年代中离开；后以巡演/录音节奏吉他回归。

相关：把西雅图–洛杉矶朋克线接入 Foo Fighters 人事连续性。

note.zh: In Utero 巡演第二吉他。
